info.title: Autosuggest
info.description:
Autosuggest is the process automation toolkit for ERPs, designed for transaction workflows. Upload examples to a dataset, and Autosuggest trains models that suggest target values for new inputs.

**Hosts:** `api.prod.asgt.visma.ai` for production and `api.stag.asgt.visma.ai` for staging.

**Authentication:** send your project token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See [Authentication](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/authentication/).

**Errors:** a failed call returns an HTTP error status with a JSON body that holds `code`, `message` and `details`.

**Guides:** [Autosuggest v2](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/autosuggest-v2/getting-started/) and [limits and rate limits](https://docs.vml.visma.ai/rate-limit/).

tags.name: SuggesterService
tags.description: Get suggestions from the model trained on a dataset.

tags.name: DatasetService
tags.description: Manage datasets and the examples Autosuggest trains on.

post.description:
The dataset starts empty. The first example you add sets its type, and adding examples
schedules a training, so no model exists until you add examples and the training is done.
Returns 409 if a dataset with this name already exists. You can reuse the name of a deleted
dataset, but the new dataset keeps the deleted one's tags and retention policy.
Returns 400 if the name or a tag doesn't match the allowed format.

get.description:
Returns the dataset's name, type, tags, retention policy and timestamps.
Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist or has been deleted.

delete.description:
Deletes the dataset and its examples, and returns the deleted dataset. The call returns as
soon as the deletion is accepted, and the examples are removed shortly afterwards.
Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist or is already deleted.

put.summary: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Create or update a dataset.

delete.summary: Remove a dataset's examples, but keep its models.
delete.description:
Future trainings only use examples added after this call, and the existing models stay
available for suggestions. Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist.

post.summary: Add an example to a dataset.
post.description:
The first example sets the dataset's type, and every later example must use the same data
structure. Adding examples schedules a training: about a minute later while the dataset is
less than an hour old, otherwise 24 hours later in production and within minutes on staging.
Examples added while a training is scheduled or running are picked up by the next training.
Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist, and 400 if the example has no target values or a
field has the wrong format.

put.summary: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Add or update an example.

parameters.name: example.id
parameters.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Ignored for now. It's meant to identify an example so that
PUT /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/examples/{example.id} can update it, and that endpoint
returns 501. If you set it, it must be a UUID.

post.summary: Add several examples to a dataset.
post.description:
Works like POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/examples for each example, and schedules one
training. Returns 400 if the list of examples is empty.

post.summary: Suggest target values for several inputs, or 404 without a model.
post.description:
Works like POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}:batchSuggest, but returns 404 if the dataset has
no trained model yet or doesn't exist.

get.description:
Returns the most recent models, newest first. Set how many with options.limit, from 1 to
100. The default is 10. Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist.

parameters.name: options.limit
parameters.description: Number of models to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

get.description:
Returns the most recent trainings, newest first. Set how many with options.limit, from 1 to
100. The default is 10. Returns 404 if the dataset doesn't exist.

parameters.name: options.limit
parameters.description: Number of trainings to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

post.summary: Suggest target values for several inputs.
post.description:
Works like POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}:suggest, with one prediction per input, in the
same order. If the dataset has no trained model yet or doesn't exist, it returns 200 with no
predictions instead of 404. To get a 404 in that case, use
POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/model:batchSuggest.

post.summary: Suggest target values for one input.
post.description:
Uses the dataset's current model. Each target returns up to suggestLimit candidates,
highest confidence first, each with its confidence level.
Returns 404 if the dataset has no trained model yet or doesn't exist, and 400 if the input
sets no data structure or an option has an invalid value.

delete.summary: Delete all datasets with a tag.
delete.description:
Deletes every one of your datasets that has the tag, with their examples. Dataset names
don't matter, only the tag. The examples are removed shortly after the call returns.
Returns 200 even if no dataset has the tag.

parameters.name: tagName
parameters.description:
The tag. It must use letters, digits, ".", "_", ">" and "-", starting with a letter, digit
or ".", up to 256 bytes, so tags with spaces can't be used here.

get.summary: List the trainings of all your datasets.
get.description:
Returns the most recent trainings across your datasets, newest first, each with its
dataset. Set how many with options.limit, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

parameters.name: options.limit
parameters.description: Number of trainings to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence level of a suggested value. Levels are set for each target from the model's
evaluation, so they give more stable results across model upgrades than the score. Use them
to decide whether to trust a suggestion.

 - UNKNOWN: No level.
 - ULTRA_HIGH: Only returned with the ULTRA tier, for a VERY_HIGH answer that a second check confirms.

examples.description: The examples to add. At least one is required.

targetValues.description: The correct value for each target. At least one is required.

example.description: An example to train on: input data and the target values it should give.

DatasetServiceCreateOrUpdateExampleBody.description: Request for PUT /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/examples/{example.id}, which isn't implemented.

ModelInputType.description: How the model takes its input. The service uses it to run the model.

candidates.description: The suggested values, highest confidence first.

unknownTargetClass.description:
Whether an example's value for this target is one the model wasn't trained on. The
suggest endpoints don't fill it in.

inputs.description: The inputs to get suggestions for. Each one must set a data structure.

SuggesterServiceBatchSuggestBody.description:
Request body for POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}:batchSuggest and
POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/model:batchSuggest.

inputs.description: The inputs to get suggestions for. Each one must set a data structure.

SuggesterServiceModelBatchSuggestBody.description:
Request body for POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}:batchSuggest and
POST /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/model:batchSuggest.

TargetCandidate.description: A suggested value for a target.

precision.description: Precision of the answers at this threshold: the share of them that were correct.

confidence.description: The confidence threshold these results apply to.

answerRate.description: Share of the evaluation examples that got an answer at this threshold.

TargetMetricsMetric.description: Evaluation results at one confidence threshold.

datasetSize.description: Size of the dataset the model was trained on, in examples.

trainingSize.description: Number of examples used for training.

confidenceScores.description: Evaluation metrics for each target, at precisions of 0.8, 0.9 and 0.95 where available.

datasetType.description:
Type of the dataset the model was trained on: bank, scanned-invoice or
electronic-invoice-line.

targetToConfidenceThresholds.description: For each target, the confidence value at which each confidence level starts.

targetToClassCount.description: For each target, the number of classes, that is distinct values, it has.

dataset.description: The dataset the model was trained on. Only its consumer, name and type are filled in.

targets.description: Names of the targets the model predicts.

asgtv2typeModel.description: A model trained on a dataset.

value.description:
The confidence score. Higher means more likely, but use level to decide whether to trust
a suggestion.

confidenceThresholds.description: The confidence value at which each level starts.

typeData.description:
Input data for an example or a suggestion. Set exactly one of transaction, invoice or
invoiceLine. The first example in a dataset sets its type, bank, scanned-invoice or
electronic-invoice-line, and every later example and suggest input must use the same
structure.

consumer.description: Name of the project the dataset belongs to.

type.description:
Type of data in the dataset: bank, scanned-invoice or electronic-invoice-line. With the v2
API, the first example you add sets it, and it's empty until then.

tags.description: Tags the dataset was created with.

targets.description:
Names of the dataset's targets, as given when a dataset is created with the v1 API. It's
empty for datasets created with the v2 API.

createdAt.description: When the dataset was created, or created again after it was deleted.

updatedAt.description: [NOT IMPLEMENTED] Not kept up to date, so it's normally 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z.

size.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Always empty. It's meant to be the number of examples within the
retention window.

truncatedAt.description: When the dataset was last truncated. It's 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z if it never was.

typeDataset.description: A dataset of examples that Autosuggest trains models on.

targetValues.description: The correct value for each target. At least one is required.

id.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Ignored for now. It's meant to identify an example so that
PUT /v2/datasets/{datasetName}/examples/{example.id} can update it, and that endpoint
returns 501. If you set it, it must be a UUID.

typeExample.description: An example to train on: input data and the target values it should give.

text.description: Text of the document, such as its OCR text or other text you have on record.

typeInvoice.description: A scanned invoice or receipt, as text. Use it for scanned-invoice datasets.

itemId.description: ID of the item, such as a global product ID.

text.description: Text of the line, such as the item's description or name.

issueDate.description: Issue date of the invoice, as an RFC 3339 timestamp such as "2026-04-15T12:32:55Z".

customerRef.description: Reference to the invoice's recipient, such as the customer's name.

currency.description: Currency of the invoice, as text.

typeInvoiceLine.description:
One line of an electronic invoice, with the details of its invoice. Send each line as its
own example and repeat the invoice details in each one. Use it for electronic-invoice-line
datasets.

typeModelFile.description: A file of a trained model.

targets.description: One entry per target of the model.

unknownTokenPercentage.description:
Share of the input's tokens the model doesn't know, from 0 to 1. The suggest endpoints don't
fill it in.

typePrediction.description: Suggestions for one input, with one entry per target.

maxDays.description:
Number of days examples count for training. Older examples are left out of training. The
default is 180, which also applies when you send 0.

typeRetentionPolicy.description: How long examples are used for training.

id.description: Your own ID for the supplier. Letters and digits only, up to 64 bytes.

globalId.description: Global ID of the supplier, such as its VAT number.

numberOfClasses.description: Number of classes in the dataset.

avgSamplePerClass.description: Average number of examples per class.

avgLabelsPerInconsistentSample.description: Average number of labels per inconsistent example.

percentSamplesNotInTargetVocab.description: Percentage of examples whose value isn't in the target's vocabulary.

targetTrainSize.description: Number of training examples with a value for this target.

targetTestSize.description: Number of test or validation examples with a value for this target.

typeTargetMetrics.description: Evaluation metrics of a model for one target.

name.description:
Name of the target, such as "account". Use letters, digits, ".", "_", ">" and "-",
starting with a letter, digit or ".", up to 256 bytes.

value.description: The value for this target, such as "002".

typeTargetValue.description: A target and its value in an example.

typeTier.description:
Service tier for suggestions. The v2 suggest endpoints use it, and the v1 API always runs as
STANDARD.

 - STANDARD: The default.
 - ULTRA: Also has a second model check each VERY_HIGH answer, and returns the answer as ULTRA_HIGH
when the check agrees.

status.description: Always empty, because the listings only return active trainings. Use trainingStatus.

trainingStatus.description:
State of the training. It's SCHEDULED until its start time and PENDING once it's handed to
a worker, and it ends as DONE or FAILED. Other in-progress states can appear while it runs.

trainingStatusMessage.description: More about the state, such as why the training failed.

finishTime.description:
When the training finished. It's 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z until the training is DONE, and for
failed trainings.

dataset.description:
The dataset the training ran on, with its consumer, name and type. Only GET /v2/trainings
fills it in.

scheduleTime.description: When the training is set to start.

text.description: Text of the bank transaction, such as its statement text.

typeTransaction.description: A bank transaction. Use it for bank datasets.

predictions.description: One prediction per input, in the same order.

model.description:
The model that made the predictions. Only its version is filled in, and it's empty when the
dataset has no model.

productTypeSuggestions.description:
Product type candidates for each input's text, in the same order, when includeProductTypes
is true.

v2ConfidenceLevel.description:
Confidence level of a product type candidate, from VERY_LOW to VERY_HIGH. UNKNOWN means the
model gave no level.

datasetName.description:
Name of the new dataset. Use letters, digits, ".", "_", ">" and "-", starting with a
letter, digit or ".", up to 256 bytes.

tags.description:
Tags for the dataset, such as a customer ID, so you can delete all datasets with a tag
later with DELETE /v2/tags/{tagName}. Each tag can use letters, digits, spaces, "_", ".",
">" and "-", up to 64 bytes, and tags must be unique. Only tags without spaces can be used
to delete datasets.

limit.description: Number of models to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.

v2ProductType.description:
The product types a text can be classified into. UNDEFINED isn't a product type: it's the
empty value.

type.description:
The product type, such as ACCOUNTING_SOFTWARE. It's left out when the model returns a
label that has no product type.

label.description: The product type's name in words, such as "Accounting software".

confidence.description:
The model's confidence score for this candidate. Use confidenceLevel to decide whether to
trust it.

v2ProductTypeCandidate.description: A product type candidate for a text.

candidates.description: The candidates, ranked by the model.

v2ProductTypeSuggestion.description: Product type candidates for one text.

suggestLimit.description: Maximum number of candidates per target. The default is 10.

minConfidence.description:
The confidence level you need. Candidates below it aren't removed, so filter on each
candidate's confidence.level yourself. When a target's best candidate is below this level,
the service tries to find a better answer and uses it if it reaches the level. The default
is HIGH. ULTRA_HIGH isn't accepted.

modelType.description:
[NOT IMPLEMENTED] Ignored: suggestions always come from the dataset's current model. If you
set it, it must be DEFAULT, TENSORFLOW or ONNX.

includeProductTypes.description:
When true, the response also has product type candidates for the text of each input. The
default is false.

v2SuggestOptions.description: Options for the suggest endpoints. All of them are optional.

model.description: The model that made the prediction. Only its version is filled in.

productTypeSuggestions.description: Product type candidates for the input's text, when includeProductTypes is true.

limit.description: Number of trainings to return, from 1 to 100. The default is 10.
